findings.current: 여기까지 들으면 저는 당시 남긴 데이터를 찾아보고 싶습니다. 매번 설정을 누가 기록했을까요?
findings.proposed: 여기까지 들으면 저는 당시 남긴 데이터를 찾아보고 싶습니다. 매번 어떻게 설정했는지 기록해 둔 사람이 있었을까요?
findings.reason: Source asks whether anyone recorded each setting (有人記下每次怎麼設嗎？), leaving the existence of records open. 누가 기록했을까요? asks who recorded them and shifts the question toward an existing recorder; the next source line specifically says no temperature data were recorded. Restore the yes/no uncertainty and what was set each time.
